ended.reason: Closed at the owner's direction. Eight of the eleven owned dossiers are terminal -- six `answered`, `0009` and `0026` `superseded` -- and the three that were not, `0014`, `0021` and `0034`, were released to `unclaimed` on the same day, each with its single member still `un-started`. What it built: the shared run index -- `artifact_run_begin`/`finalize`, the append-only `MANIFEST.md`, the computed `official/` pointer -- and the conversion of the producers onto it, across Revisions 116-134. What it returned for on 2026-09-04: `entry` and `initial` became first-wins, which is the rule that catches a bookend recorded after its phase; `0012`'s premise was corrected while it was still open, having claimed a directory was tracked that git cannot track; and the seven evidence writes that rule and `0030` D7 owed were made under a grant -- four pins on `bookends/` and three retroactive `rename` rows. What it got wrong and what corrected it: `0030` D7's closing claim that every member then carried a decision was false and this session did not notice, `pre-image-capture-conformance-20260903-194532` caught it and added D8; the claim that an unpinned rebuild would flip four pointers silently was disproved by running it, Revision 193's own reporting fires on each; and an early reading of `restore-git-entry`'s FAILs as the honest entry state was wrong, which the owner corrected and which became `0034`. It stood `handoff` from 2026-09-02 to 2026-09-13 without ever satisfying the precondition: no successor existed and nothing was transferred.
